title: Bloodforge - The Hemalescence
description: This mod adds three bio-materials and a few other things.
body:
Bloodforge is a minecraft mod that adds multiple materials.

The definition of Hemalescent is something that has grown from blood, and likewise Hemalescence is something growing from blood or maturing blood.

______________

-Bloodsteel

--Can be mined in caves, imagine diamonds but less strong and early game



-Carbon Hemasteel

--Crafted with bloodsteel and a few other things

--This alloy is stronger than bloodsteel



-Hemalescent

--Smithed on diamond tools using Hemalescent Flesh and Blood

--Stronger than netherite

--A hemalescent chestplate and helmet are strong enough to fill out the armor bar completely.

______________

Non-Material things:

-Bleeding Enchantment

--For swords only, causes the victim to get a bleeding effect for 5 seconds



-Bleeding potion and items

--Piercing arrow causes someone to bleed.

--Drink the bleeding potion if you want to bleed I guess.

--Lingering and Splash are the most useful, imagine the particles are broken glass and your opponents walk on it and bleed.



-The Bloodgatherer and the Deepslate handle

--The Bloodgatherer is a blade that collects blood from the user at the cost of half a heart.

--The deepslate handle is used in the Bloodgatherer's crafting recipe instead of a stick.



-Blood, Dried Blood, Faux Dried Blood, and Bone Marrow

--Blood is very useful in this mod, being required directly or indirectly in most recipes in this mod.

--Dried Blood can be crafted by cooking Blood in a furnace.

--Faux Dried Blood can be crafted with one redstone dust and one peice of Bone Marrow.

--Bone Marrow can be made by putting a bone in a stonecutter.




-Pool of Blood

--In the world, you can find pools of blood surrounded by blocks of Hemalescent Flesh.

--Buckets of Liquid Blood can be made with six Blood and a bucket, although it can be found in the middle of pools of blood.

______________

There are bugs in the release version of this mod, although they are very minor (such as the pools of blood removing the grass blocks around it) and will be fixed in the next update.
